title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Accessible Canada listings validated before Glassdoor's human-verification block ended the run. Scores apply the profile's unreachable-location cap.
latest_update: Updated September 21, 2026 - two full descriptions validated before access was blocked.

rows.title: AKS Platform Engineer (1891)
rows.location: Toronto hybrid - 2 days/week; outside reachable hybrid geography
rows.gap: Requires five years of hands-on AKS/Kubernetes administration; Marc's Kubernetes depth is provisioning and automation rather than deep cluster operations.

rows.title: Systems Integration & Operations Engineer - Industrial Automation
rows.location: London, Ontario - in person; outside reachable geography
rows.gap: Requires industrial automation/embedded systems experience and in-person work in London; compensation is also below target.

could_not_validate: Senior Software Engineer - Dev Ops - CARFAX: opening the detail page triggered Glassdoor's human-verification block, so the posting was not scored.

notes_sections.heading: Search limitation
items: Glassdoor displayed 676 DevOps Engineer results and 7,286 Platform Engineer results in Canada. Further detail-page validation stopped immediately when the CARFAX page triggered the site's human-verification protection.
No verification challenge was solved or bypassed, and no sign-in, save, Easy Apply or other write-side control was used.

method: The DevOps and Platform rotations began in a real browser. Sixteen visible results were title-skimmed and two complete descriptions were captured before Glassdoor blocked the next detail page; the remaining keyword rotation could not be completed safely.
